headline: Susceptibility explains ~51% of where cases concentrate (McFadden R2=0.51); ~49% is irreducible spark placement. National activity is 81% short-horizon predictable, but that is transmission momentum, not importation skill.

spatial.interpretation: susceptibility explains this McFadden-R2 share of case-concentration deviance beyond population; the remainder is irreducible spark placement
spatial.question: Does the susceptibility surface predict WHERE cases concentrate, beyond population?

temporal.caveat: MomentumR2 reflects transmission persistence (ongoing outbreaks), not importation-rate predictability; it is an upper bound on temporal skill.
temporal.question: How predictable is national weekly activity short-horizon?
